Class GameLevel

DynamicScene
org.example.scenes.GameLevel
public class GameLevel extends DynamicScene
The active gameplay scene containing the paddle, ball, bricks, and HUD.

Tracks score and lives, speeds up the ball every 6 bricks, and transitions to the end screen on win or game over.

    • addScore

      public void addScore(Coordinate2D destroyedBrickPosition)
      Called by Ball when a brick is destroyed. Increases the score, optionally speeds up the ball, triggers powerup spawning, and checks for a win.
      Parameters:
      destroyedBrickPosition - the location where the brick was destroyed (used for powerup spawning)

    • loseLife

      public void loseLife()
      Called by Ball when it falls below the bottom border. Decrements lives and transitions to the game-over screen if none remain.

    • addLife

      public void addLife()
      Adds one life and updates the HUD.

    • activateWidePaddle

      public void activateWidePaddle()
      Activates (or extends) the wide-paddle powerup timer. If already active, the duration is extended by the powerup duration.
